## Checklist

- [ ] The theme is in `<my-username>/<theme>/`, in lowercase, with `theme.css`, `README.md`, and a screenshot
- [ ] It's my own original work: no names, logos, characters, artwork, or fonts from games, films, TV, or brands
- [ ] Any font in it has a license that allows sharing, with the license file in the folder
- [ ] I tried it in Outpost, on a wide screen and a phone, and with reduced effects
- [ ] I added a row for it to the table in `README.md`
